nodes.label: Life Map 2 Product and Technical Specification
nodes.norm_label: life map 2 product and technical specification

nodes.label: Progressive Goal Chains
nodes.rationale: Each life area is a chain of steps where one step enables the next until the final goal.

nodes.label: Records Are Evidence
nodes.rationale: Dated records provide evidence of workouts, finished books, and app milestones.

nodes.label: Weekly Review and Rescoping
nodes.rationale: A weekly review inspects missing records and stuck steps, then re-scopes or reopens them.

nodes.label: What the App Could Not Express
nodes.norm_label: what the app could not express

nodes.label: Missing Numeric Metrics and Progress
nodes.rationale: Targets and current measurements cannot be represented as numeric progress fields.

nodes.label: Missing Task Descriptions
nodes.rationale: Tasks have titles and notes but no first-class description field.

nodes.label: Missing Dedicated Series Timeline
nodes.rationale: The calendar eases day-by-day inspection but a per-series history view remains open.

nodes.label: Code Review Bug List and Refactor Suggestions
nodes.norm_label: code review bug list and refactor suggestions

nodes.label: Domain Test Suite and CI
nodes.rationale: Pure domain rules are high-value test targets and lint plus type checks should gate changes.

nodes.label: Object Local Progressive Actions
nodes.rationale: Actions live with their object, use progressive disclosure, and remain undoable.
